525	    # -- audit stream ---------------------------------------------------
526	    def list_audit(self, tenant, action=None, run_id=None, limit=100, after=0):
527	        """Read the tenant's audit stream; never mutates any state.
528	
529	        Returns ``(items, next_after)`` where ``items`` are the tenant's
530	        audit records with ``sequence > after`` (optionally filtered by
531	        ``action`` and/or ``run_id``) in ascending sequence order, at most
532	        ``limit`` of them, and ``next_after`` is the sequence of the last
533	        record of the page, or ``None`` when no further records follow.
534	        Only the requesting tenant's own stream is ever read.
535	        """
536	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
537	        if action is not None:
538	            if not isinstance(action, str) or not action.strip():
539	                raise WorkflowError("action must be a non-empty string", "bad_action")
540	            action = action.strip()
541	        if run_id is not None:
542	            if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id.strip():
543	                raise WorkflowError("run_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_run_id")
544	            run_id = run_id.strip()
545	        if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= 1000:
546	            raise WorkflowError("limit must be an integer between 1 and 1000", "bad_limit")
547	        if isinstance(after, bool) or not isinstance(after, int) or after < 0:
548	            raise WorkflowError("after must be a non-negative integer", "bad_after")
549	        with self.store.locked():
550	            matched = [r for r in self.store.load_audit(tenant) if r["sequence"] > after]
551	        if action is not None:
552	            matched = [r for r in matched if r["action"] == action]
553	        if run_id is not None:
554	            matched = [r for r in matched if r.get("run_id") == run_id]
555	        matched.sort(key=lambda r: r["sequence"])
556	        page = matched[:limit]
557	        next_after = page[-1]["sequence"] if len(matched) > limit else None
558	        return page, next_after

651	            )

653	            record["updated_at"] = self._iso(now)

661	    def _worker_view(self, record, now=None):

673	    def register_worker(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=None):
674	        """Register ``worker_id`` for ``tenant`` (or refresh its expiry).
675	
676	        Returns ``(record, created)`` where ``created`` is ``True`` for the
677	        first registration (HTTP 201) and ``False`` for a repeat that
678	        refreshed an existing record (HTTP 200).  Registration never writes
679	        run history.
680	        """
681	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
682	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
683	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
684	        now = self.now()
685	        with self.store.locked():
686	            workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
687	            existing = workers.get(worker_id)
688	            deadline = now + lease
689	            at = self._iso(now)
690	            if existing is None:
691	                record = {
692	                    "worker_id": worker_id,
693	                    "registered_at": at,
694	                    "last_heartbeat": at,
695	                    "expires_at": self._iso(deadline),
696	                    "expires_at_epoch": deadline,
697	                }
698	                created = True
699	            else:
700	                # A repeat registration simply refreshes the expiry; the
701	                # original registered_at is preserved.
702	                record = dict(existing)
703	                record.update(last_heartbeat=at, expires_at=self._iso(deadline),
704	                              expires_at_epoch=deadline)
705	                created = False
706	            workers[worker_id] = record
707	            self.store.save_workers(tenant, workers)
708	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "worker.register", worker_id=worker_id)
709	            return self._worker_view(record, now), created

711	    def heartbeat_worker(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=None):
712	        """Heartbeat a registered worker.
713	
714	        The new expiry is the later of the old one and ``now +
715	        lease_seconds``.  Unknown workers raise ``unknown_worker`` (404) and
716	        workers whose registration has expired raise ``worker_expired``
717	        (409); an expired worker must re-register.
718	        """
719	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
720	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
721	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
722	        now = self.now()
723	        with self.store.locked():
724	            workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
725	            record = workers.get(worker_id)
726	            if record is None:
727	                raise WorkflowError("unknown worker: %s" % worker_id, "unknown_worker")
728	            if now >= float(record["expires_at_epoch"]):
729	                raise ConflictError(
730	                    "worker_expired: registration of worker %s has expired; re-register"
731	                    % worker_id,
732	                    "worker_expired",
733	                )
734	            deadline = max(float(record["expires_at_epoch"]), now + lease)
735	            record = dict(record)
736	            record.update(last_heartbeat=self._iso(now), expires_at=self._iso(deadline),
737	                          expires_at_epoch=deadline)
738	            workers[worker_id] = record
739	            self.store.save_workers(tenant, workers)
740	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "worker.heartbeat", worker_id=worker_id)

780	    # -- lease expiry --------------------------------------------------
781	    def _expire_leases(self, run, now):
782	        """Release leases past their deadline; each one records a takeover."""
783	        reclaimed = []
784	        for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: run["order_index"].get(s, 0)):
785	            step = run["steps"][sid]
786	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
787	                continue
788	            if step.get("lease_deadline") is None or float(step["lease_deadline"]) > now:
789	                continue
790	            holder = step["worker_id"]
791	            step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None, ready_at=self._iso())
792	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "takeover", attempt=step["attempt"], worker_id=holder)
793	            reclaimed.append(sid)
794	        return reclaimed

796	    # -- claim / complete / fail ---------------------------------------
797	    def claim(self, tenant, run_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
798	        """Lease the next ready step, or return ``None`` when none is ready.
799	
800	        A delayed run (a future ``not_before``) cannot be activated early:
801	        claims before the start time return ``None`` without touching its
802	        state, history or ``updated_at``.  The first claim at or after the
803	        start time opens the root nodes (one ``ready``/``waiting`` event each)
804	        and then leases at most one task under the usual order and quota; a
805	        run whose roots are all approvals activates and still returns ``None``.
806	
807	        Once the tenant has any registered worker the claim must come from an
808	        active registration (``worker_not_registered`` / ``worker_expired``);
809	        a tenant with no registrations keeps the legacy non-empty-id rule.
810	
811	        A ready step whose retry backoff is still pending
812	        (``next_attempt_at`` in the future) is not leased; other ready tasks
813	        whose backoff has elapsed are handed out in the usual order instead.
814	        When nothing is leased and no lease takeover or root activation
815	        happened, the run's state, history and ``updated_at`` are left
816	        exactly as stored.
817	
818	        When the tenant has a concurrency quota configured (see
819	        :meth:`set_quota`), all of the tenant's runs share one active-lease
820	        budget: expired leases across every run are reclaimed first (with
821	        the usual ``takeover`` events, kept even when the budget turns out
822	        full), and a full budget returns ``None`` without a claim event.
823	        Tenants without a configured quota keep the legacy behavior exactly.
824	        """
825	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
826	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
827	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
828	                or lease_seconds <= 0:
829	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
830	        now = self.now()
831	        with self.store.locked():
832	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
833	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
834	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
835	            # Once a tenant has any registered worker, claims require an
836	            # active registration; a tenant without records keeps the legacy
837	            # "any non-empty worker_id" rule.
838	            self._check_worker_registration(tenant, worker_id.strip(), now)
839	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
840	            not_before = run.get("not_before")
841	            if not_before is not None and float(not_before) > now:
842	                # Still sleeping: activation happens only via a due claim.
843	                return None
844	            tenant_quota = self._tenant_quota_limit(tenant)
845	            if tenant_quota is None:
846	                reclaimed = self._expire_leases(run, now)
847	            else:
848	                # A configured tenant quota shares one lease budget across
849	                # all of the tenant's runs: reclaim every expired lease of
850	                # the tenant under this lock, then count what survives.
851	                others = [r for r in self.store.load_all_runs(tenant)
852	                          if r["run_id"] != run_id]
853	                self._reclaim_tenant_leases(others, now)
854	                reclaimed = self._expire_leases(run, now)
855	                active = _active_lease_count(run, now) + sum(
856	                    _active_lease_count(other, now) for other in others)
857	                if active >= tenant_quota:

859	                    # no claim event and no other state change is added.

861	                        run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
862	                        run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
863	                        self.store.save_run(run)
864	                    return None
865	            opened_ready, opened_waiting = self._open_root_nodes(run)
866	            now_iso = self._iso()
867	            candidates = [s for s in run["steps"].values()
868	                          if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)]
869	            index = run["order_index"]
870	            quota = run.get("max_parallelism")
871	            at_quota = quota is not None and _active_lease_count(run, now) >= int(quota)
872	            step = (min(candidates, key=lambda s: (index.get(s["id"], 0), s["id"]))
873	                    if candidates and not at_quota else None)
874	            previous = run["status"]
875	            if step is not None:
876	                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=None,
877	                            lease_deadline=now + float(lease_seconds), started_at=self._iso())
878	                self._event(run, run_id, step["id"], "claim", attempt=step["attempt"],
879	                            worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=step["lease_deadline"])
880	            elif not reclaimed and not opened_ready and not opened_waiting:
881	                # Nothing to lease and nothing else changed: keep the stored
882	                # state, history and updated_at untouched.
883	                return None
884	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
885	            if step is not None and run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
886	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
887	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
888	            self.store.save_run(run)
889	            return dict(step) if step is not None else None

891	    def claim_fair(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
892	        """Lease one task from the tenant's least-claimed eligible run.
893	
894	        Scans every run of the tenant.  First, sleeping runs whose
895	        ``not_before`` has come due are activated (root nodes opened, one
896	        ``ready``/``waiting`` event each) in ``run_id`` order.  Then the
897	        candidates — runs that are not terminal, not still sleeping, hold at
898	        least one ``ready`` ordinary task whose retry backoff has elapsed
899	        (``next_attempt_at`` reached) and have not reached their
900	        ``max_parallelism`` — are ordered by fairness: the number of
901	        ``claim`` events in the run's history (fewest first), then
902	        ``created_at``, then ``run_id``.  A run holding only not-yet-due
903	        retries is skipped and its fairness count is left alone.  Expired
904	        leases are reclaimed with the usual ``takeover`` events before slots
905	        are counted, exactly like the single-run claim.  The winner leases
906	        its next due task in ``(topological index, step id)`` order,
907	        recording the usual ``claim`` and, when the run leaves ``pending``,
908	        ``run_started`` events.
909	
910	        Returns ``(run_id, step)`` or ``None`` when no run is eligible; at
911	        most one task is leased per call.  The fairness count is rebuilt
912	        from the append-only history on every call, so restarts, replay and
913	        concurrent callers (serialized by the store lock) all agree.
914	        Worker-registration gating matches the single-run claim.
915	
916	        A configured tenant concurrency quota (see :meth:`set_quota`) adds a
917	        shared active-lease budget across all of the tenant's runs: expired
918	        leases tenant-wide are reclaimed first (takeovers are kept), and a
919	        full budget returns ``None`` before any run is activated or leased.
920	        """
921	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
922	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
923	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
924	        now = self.now()
925	        with self.store.locked():
926	            self._check_worker_registration(tenant, worker_id, now)
927	            runs = self.store.load_all_runs(tenant)
928	            tenant_quota = self._tenant_quota_limit(tenant)
929	            if tenant_quota is not None:
930	                # Shared tenant budget: reclaim every expired lease of the
931	                # tenant under this lock, then count the surviving active
932	                # leases.  A full budget returns nothing; the takeovers
933	                # recorded by the reclaim are kept.
934	                self._reclaim_tenant_leases(runs, now)
935	                if sum(_active_lease_count(run, now) for run in runs) >= tenant_quota:
936	                    return None
937	            # Activate due sleeping runs in run_id order; already-activated
938	            # runs are left untouched.  Terminal runs (including a cancelled
939	            # run whose roots were never opened) are never activated.
940	            for run in runs:
941	                if run["status"] in TERMINAL_RUN_STATES:
942	                    continue
943	                not_before = run.get("not_before")
944	                if not_before is None or float(not_before) > now:
945	                    continue
946	                if _roots_opened(run):
947	                    continue
948	                self._open_root_nodes(run)
949	                run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
950	                run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
951	                self.store.save_run(run)
952	            # Pick the fairest eligible run.
953	            now_iso = self._iso(now)
954	            best_key, best_run, best_previous = None, None, None
955	            for run in runs:
956	                if run["status"] in TERMINAL_RUN_STATES:
957	                    continue
958	                not_before = run.get("not_before")
959	                if not_before is not None and float(not_before) > now:
960	                    continue
961	                previous = run["status"]
962	                reclaimed = self._expire_leases(run, now)
963	                if reclaimed:
964	                    run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
965	                    run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
966	                    self.store.save_run(run)
967	                ready = [s for s in run["steps"].values()
968	                         if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)]
969	                if not ready:
970	                    continue
971	                quota = run.get("max_parallelism")
972	                if quota is not None and _active_lease_count(run, now) >= int(quota):
973	                    continue
974	                claims = sum(1 for e in run["history"] if e.get("type") == "claim")
975	                key = (claims, run.get("created_at") or "", run["run_id"])
976	                if best_key is None or key < best_key:
977	                    best_key, best_run, best_previous = key, run, previous
978	            if best_run is None:
979	                return None
980	            run = best_run
981	            index = run["order_index"]
982	            step = min((s for s in run["steps"].values()
983	                        if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)),
984	                       key=lambda s: (index.get(s["id"], 0), s["id"]))
985	            step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=None,
986	                        lease_deadline=now + lease, started_at=self._iso())
987	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], step["id"], "claim", attempt=step["attempt"],
988	                        worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=step["lease_deadline"])
989	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
990	            if run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and best_previous == RUN_PENDING:
991	                self._event(run, run["run_id"], None, "run_started")
992	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
993	            self.store.save_run(run)
994	            return run["run_id"], dict(step)

996	    def heartbeat(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
997	        """Renew the lease on a running step held by ``worker_id``.
998	
999	        The new deadline is the later of the current one and
1000	        ``now + lease_seconds``; only the deadline and ``updated_at`` change.
1001	        A renewal that would not extend the deadline returns the run
1002	        unchanged and appends no history.
1003	        """
1004	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
1005	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
1006	        if not isinstance(step_id, str) or not step_id.strip():
1007	            raise WorkflowError("step_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_step")
1008	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
1009	                or not math.isfinite(lease_seconds) or lease_seconds <= 0:
1010	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
1011	        now = self.now()
1012	        with self.store.locked():
1013	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
1014	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
1015	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
1016	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
1017	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
1018	                raise ConflictError("run %s is cancelled" % run_id, "run_cancelled")
1019	            if run["status"] in (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED):
1020	                raise ConflictError("run %s is already %s" % (run_id, run["status"]),
1021	                                    "run_finished")
1022	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
1023	            if step is None:
1024	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
1025	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
1026	                raise ConflictError(
1027	                    "step %s is an approval node; use /decision" % step_id, "not_a_task"
1028	                )
1029	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
1030	                raise LeaseError("step %s is not running" % step_id, "lease_not_held")
1031	            if step["worker_id"] != worker_id:
1032	                raise LeaseError("step %s lease is not held by worker %s" % (step_id, worker_id))
1033	            deadline = float(step["lease_deadline"])
1034	            if now >= deadline:
1035	                raise LeaseError("lease for step %s expired" % step_id, "lease_expired")
1036	            new_deadline = max(deadline, now + float(lease_seconds))
1037	            if new_deadline <= deadline:
1038	                return run
1039	            step["lease_deadline"] = new_deadline
1040	            self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "heartbeat", attempt=step["attempt"],
1041	                        worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=new_deadline)
1042	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
1043	            self.store.save_run(run)
1044	            return run

1089	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
1090	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:

1092	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
1093	            if step is None:

1114	            if run["status"] == RUN_FAILED:

1121	    def cancel(self, tenant, run_id, actor):
1122	        """Cancel an unfinished run; a repeat cancel is a no-op.
1123	
1124	        Every non-terminal node (``pending``, ``ready``, ``running`` or
1125	        ``waiting``) becomes ``cancelled`` in ``step_order``; already
1126	        ``succeeded`` nodes are left untouched.  Cancelled nodes keep their
1127	        ``attempt``, ``result`` and ``error`` and release their lease
1128	        (``worker_id``, ``lease_deadline`` and ``next_attempt_at`` are
1129	        cleared).  Each cancelled node records one ``cancel`` history event
1130	        carrying the lease holder it had and the cancelling actor, and a
1131	        final run-level ``run_cancelled`` event closes the transition; the
1132	        audit stream follows the same order.  A sleeping run (a future
1133	        ``not_before``) is cancelled without opening its root nodes.
1134	
1135	        Cancelling never deletes the run, its workflow, its idempotency
1136	        binding or its history.  A run that is already ``succeeded`` or
1137	        ``failed`` conflicts (``run_finished``); a run that is already
1138	        ``cancelled`` returns the current document without new history,
1139	        audit records or a changed ``updated_at``.
1140	        """
1141	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
1142	        if not isinstance(actor, str):
1143	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a string", "bad_actor")
1144	        actor = actor.strip()
1145	        if not actor:
1146	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a non-empty string", "bad_actor")
1147	        with self.store.locked():
1148	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
1149	            if owner is None:
1150	                raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
1151	            if owner != tenant:
1152	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
1153	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
1154	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
1155	                # Idempotent repeat: the stored document is returned as is.
1156	                return run
1157	            if run["status"] in (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED):
1158	                raise ConflictError("run %s is already %s" % (run_id, run["status"]),
1159	                                    "run_finished")
1160	            index = run["order_index"]
1161	            for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: index.get(s, 0)):
1162	                step = run["steps"][sid]
1163	                if step["status"] in (STEP_SUCCEEDED, STEP_FAILED, STEP_CANCELLED):
1164	                    continue
1165	                holder = step.get("worker_id")
1166	                step.update(status=STEP_CANCELLED, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
1167	                            next_attempt_at=None)
1168	                self._event(run, run_id, sid, "cancel", attempt=step["attempt"],
1169	                            worker_id=holder, actor=actor)
1170	            run["status"] = RUN_CANCELLED
1171	            self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_cancelled", actor=actor)
1172	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
1173	            self.store.save_run(run)
1174	            return run

1177	    def decide(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, actor, decision):
1178	        """Record a human approve/reject decision for an approval step.
1179	
1180	        Repeating the *same* decision from the *same* actor is idempotent and
1181	        returns the unchanged run; a different actor or the opposite decision
1182	        conflicts with the recorded decision.
1183	        """
1184	        if not isinstance(actor, str) or not actor.strip():
1185	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a non-empty string", "bad_actor")
1186	        actor = actor.strip()
1187	        if decision not in ("approve", "reject"):
1188	            raise WorkflowError("decision must be 'approve' or 'reject'", "bad_decision")
1189	        with self.store.locked():
1190	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
1191	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
1192	                raise ConflictError("run %s is cancelled" % run_id, "run_cancelled")
1193	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
1194	            if step is None:
1195	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
1196	            if step.get("kind") != KIND_APPROVAL:
1197	                raise ConflictError("step %s is not an approval node" % step_id, "not_an_approval")
1198	            recorded = step.get("approval")
1199	            if recorded is not None:
1200	                if recorded["actor"] == actor and recorded["decision"] == decision:
1201	                    return run
1202	                raise ConflictError(
1203	                    "step %s already decided by %s: %s"
1204	                    % (step_id, recorded["actor"], recorded["decision"]),
1205	                    "already_decided",
1206	                )
1207	            if step["status"] != STEP_WAITING:
1208	                raise ConflictError(
1209	                    "step %s is not waiting for a decision" % step_id, "not_waiting"
1210	                )
1211	            event = self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "decision", attempt=0, worker_id=None,
1212	                                actor=actor, decision=decision)
1213	            at = event["at"]
1214	            step["approval"] = {"actor": actor, "decision": decision, "at": at}
1215	            previous = run["status"]
1216	            if decision == "approve":
1217	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, finished_at=at)
1218	                self._open_root_nodes(run, at)
1219	                run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
1220	            else:
1221	                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at)
1222	                run["status"] = RUN_FAILED
1223	            if run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
1224	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
1225	            if run["status"] == RUN_SUCCEEDED:
1226	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_succeeded")
1227	            elif run["status"] == RUN_FAILED:
1228	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_failed")
1229	            run["updated_at"] = at
1230	            self.store.save_run(run)
1231	            return run

1233	    # -- history / replay ----------------------------------------------
1234	    def replay(self, tenant, run_id):
1235	        """Rebuild run state from the run's frozen definition and history.
1236	
1237	        Nodes are rebuilt from the normalized DAG snapshotted into the run
1238	        document at creation time, never from the workflow currently stored
1239	        under the run's ``workflow_id``: a later same-name submission may
1240	        replace that workflow, but existing runs keep their original step
1241	        order, node kinds, dependencies, ``max_attempts`` and state-machine
1242	        semantics.  Documents written before snapshots existed reconstruct
1243	        the plan from the definitions and order saved in the run itself.
1244	
1245	        The result agrees with the persisted run on every observable field —
1246	        ``run_id``, ``workflow_id``, ``step_order``, run and per-step
1247	        ``status``, ``attempt``, ``worker_id``, ``lease_deadline``,
1248	        ``next_attempt_at``, ``ready_at``, ``started_at``, ``finished_at``,
1249	        ``result``, ``error`` and ``approval`` — and the append-only history
1250	        is the sole source of transitions, so replaying again, including
1251	        after a restart, yields the identical document.
1252	        """
1253	        owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
1254	        if owner is None:
1255	            raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
1256	        if owner != tenant:
1257	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
1258	        stored = self.store.load_run(tenant, run_id)

1297	                            next_attempt_at=None)

1302	                # ready_at and no holder; started_at from the lost lease is

2	
3	Layout::
4

15	the same workflows and runs.

44	def atomic_write_json(path, payload):
45	    """Write ``payload`` as JSON to ``path`` atomically."""
46	    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
47	    if directory:
48	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
49	    tmp = "%s.tmp.%d" % (path, os.getpid())
50	    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
51	        json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
52	        handle.flush()
53	        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
54	    os.replace(tmp, path)

57	def read_json(path, default=None):
58	    try:
59	        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
60	            return json.load(handle)
61	    except FileNotFoundError:
62	        return default

65	class WorkflowStore:
66	    """Filesystem backed store for one data directory (all tenants)."""
67	
68	    def __init__(self, root, clock=None):
69	        self.root = os.path.abspath(root)
70	        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else _time.time
71	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
72	        os.makedirs(self.root, exist_ok=True)

74	    def now(self):

80	    @contextmanager
81	    def locked(self):

85	    # -- paths ---------------------------------------------------------
86	    def tenant_dir(self, tenant):

88	            raise WorkflowError("tenant must be a non-empty string", "bad_tenant")
89	        return os.path.join(self.root, tenant.strip())

91	    def workflows_path(self, tenant):

98	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "workers.json")
99	
100	    def schedules_path(self, tenant):
101	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "schedules.json")
102	
103	    def quota_path(self, tenant):
104	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "quota.json")
105

107	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "audit.json")

109	    def run_path(self, tenant, run_id):

111	
112	    def generate_run_id(self):

114	
115	    # -- workflows -----------------------------------------------------
116	    def save_workflow(self, tenant, workflow_id, steps):
117	        plan = plan_workflow(workflow_id, steps)
118	        with self._lock:
119	            data = self.load_workflows(tenant)
120	            data[plan["workflow_id"]] = plan
121	            atomic_write_json(self.workflows_path(tenant), data)

124	    def load_workflows(self, tenant):
125	        return read_json(self.workflows_path(tenant), {}) or {}
126	
127	    def get_workflow(self, tenant, workflow_id):
128	        plan = self.load_workflows(tenant).get(workflow_id)
129	        if plan is None:
130	            raise WorkflowError("unknown workflow: %s" % workflow_id, "unknown_workflow")
131	        return plan
132	
133	    # -- idempotency index --------------------------------------------
134	    def load_idempotency(self, tenant):
135	        """Return the tenant's ``{trimmed key: {"run_id": ...}}`` map."""
136	        return read_json(self.idempotency_path(tenant), {}) or {}
137	
138	    def save_idempotency(self, tenant, index):
139	        atomic_write_json(self.idempotency_path(tenant), index)
140	        return index
141	
142	    # -- worker registry ----------------------------------------------
143	    def load_workers(self, tenant):
144	        """Return the tenant's ``{worker_id: registration record}`` map."""
145	        return read_json(self.workers_path(tenant), {}) or {}
146	
147	    def save_workers(self, tenant, index):
148	        atomic_write_json(self.workers_path(tenant), index)
149	        return index
150	
151	    # -- schedule registry --------------------------------------------
152	    def load_schedules(self, tenant):
153	        """Return the tenant's ``{schedule_id: schedule record}`` map."""
154	        return read_json(self.schedules_path(tenant), {}) or {}
155	
156	    def save_schedules(self, tenant, index):
157	        atomic_write_json(self.schedules_path(tenant), index)
158	        return index
159	
160	    def schedule_exists(self, schedule_id):
161	        """Return the tenant owning ``schedule_id``, or ``None``."""
162	        for tenant in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
163	            if schedule_id in (read_json(self.schedules_path(tenant), {}) or {}):
164	                return tenant
165	        return None
166	
167	    # -- tenant concurrency quota ---------------------------------------
168	    def load_quota(self, tenant):
169	        """Return the tenant's quota record, or ``None`` when unconfigured."""
170	        return read_json(self.quota_path(tenant), None)
171	
172	    def save_quota(self, tenant, record):
173	        atomic_write_json(self.quota_path(tenant), record)
174	        return record
175	
176	    # -- audit stream ---------------------------------------------------
177	    def append_audit(self, tenant, action, at=None, run_id=None, step_id=None,
178	                     workflow_id=None, schedule_id=None, worker_id=None, actor=None):
179	        """Append one record to the tenant's audit stream.
180	
181	        The ``sequence`` is assigned under the store lock, so concurrent
182	        appends stay unique and follow commit order, and it continues from
183	        the persisted stream, so a restart keeps increasing.  Only
184	        identifiers and the actor are stored — never params, results or
185	        error text; identifiers that do not apply are ``None``.
186	        """
187	        with self._lock:
188	            path = self.audit_path(tenant)
189	            items = (read_json(path, None) or {}).get("items") or []
190	            record = {
191	                "sequence": (items[-1]["sequence"] + 1) if items else 1,
192	                "at": at if at is not None else self.now_iso(),
193	                "tenant": tenant.strip(),
194	                "action": action,
195	                "run_id": run_id,
196	                "step_id": step_id,
197	                "workflow_id": workflow_id,
198	                "schedule_id": schedule_id,
199	                "worker_id": worker_id,
200	                "actor": actor,
201	            }
202	            items.append(record)
203	            atomic_write_json(path, {"items": items})
204	            return dict(record)
205	
206	    def load_audit(self, tenant):
207	        """Return the tenant's audit records in sequence order (read-only)."""
208	        return list((read_json(self.audit_path(tenant), None) or {}).get("items") or [])
209	
210	    # -- runs ----------------------------------------------------------
211	    def save_run(self, run):
212	        atomic_write_json(self.run_path(run["tenant"], run["run_id"]), run)
213	        return run
214	
215	    def load_run(self, tenant, run_id):
216	        run = read_json(self.run_path(tenant, run_id), None)
217	        if run is None:
218	            raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
219	        return normalize_run(run)
220	
221	    def run_exists(self, run_id):
222	        """Return the tenant owning ``run_id``, or ``None``."""
223	        for tenant in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
224	            if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(self.root, tenant, "runs", "%s.json" % run_id)):
225	                return tenant
226	        return None

228	    def load_all_runs(self, tenant):
229	        """Return every run of the tenant as a list sorted by ``run_id``."""
230	        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
231	        items = []
232	        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
233	            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
234	            if run is not None:
235	                items.append(normalize_run(run))
236	        items.sort(key=lambda r: r.get("run_id", ""))
237	        return items
238	
239	    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
240	        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
241	        items = []
242	        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
243	            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
244	            if run is not None:
245	                items.append(normalize_run(run))
246	        items.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("created_at", ""), r.get("run_id", "")))
247	        if status:
248	            items = [r for r in items if r.get("status") == status]
249	        if after:
250	            position = [i for i, r in enumerate(items) if r.get("run_id") == after]
251	            items = items[position[0] + 1:] if position else []
252	        limit = max(1, int(limit))
253	        page = items[:limit]
254	        return page, (page[-1]["run_id"] if len(items) > limit else None)

257	def normalize_run(run):
258	    """Backfill fields missing from documents written by older versions.
259	
260	    Steps without ``kind`` predate approval nodes and are ordinary tasks.
261	    Runs without ``max_parallelism`` predate per-run concurrency quotas and
262	    have no limit (``None``).  Runs without ``idempotency_key`` predate
263	    tenant-scoped idempotency keys and never participate in dedup (``None``).
264	    Runs without ``not_before`` predate delayed start and begin immediately
265	    (``None``).  Runs without ``schedule_id``/``scheduled_at`` predate
266	    periodic scheduling and were created manually (``None``).  Steps without
267	    ``next_attempt_at`` predate retry backoff and are immediately claimable
268	    (``None``).  Runs without a frozen ``plan`` predate per-run DAG snapshots
269	    and reconstruct theirs from the node definitions and ``step_order`` saved
270	    in the run document itself, so replay never has to read the workflow
271	    registry (which a later same-name submission may have overwritten).
272	    Mutates and returns ``run``.
273	    """
274	    run.setdefault("max_parallelism", None)
275	    run.setdefault("idempotency_key", None)
276	    run.setdefault("not_before", None)
277	    run.setdefault("schedule_id", None)
278	    run.setdefault("scheduled_at", None)
279	    for step in run.get("steps", {}).values():
280	        step.setdefault("kind", KIND_TASK)
281	        step.setdefault("approval", None)
282	        step.setdefault("next_attempt_at", None)
283	    if not run.get("plan"):
284	        run["plan"] = plan_from_run(run)
285	    return run
286	
287	
288	def plan_from_run(run):
289	    """Reconstruct a normalized plan from the definitions frozen in a run.
290	
291	    The run document keeps each node's ``kind``, ``depends_on`` and
292	    ``max_attempts`` together with ``step_order``; those are exactly the
293	    fields a plan needs, so documents written before plans were snapshotted
294	    remain replayable even after the workflow of the same id is overwritten
295	    or deleted.
296	    """
297	    steps = run.get("steps") or {}
298	    order = [sid for sid in (run.get("step_order") or sorted(steps)) if sid in steps]
299	    ordered = [
300	        {
301	            "id": steps[sid]["id"],
302	            "depends_on": list(steps[sid].get("depends_on") or []),
303	            "max_attempts": steps[sid]["max_attempts"],
304	            "kind": steps[sid].get("kind", KIND_TASK),
305	        }
306	        for sid in order
307	    ]
308	    return {
309	        "workflow_id": run.get("workflow_id"),
310	        "steps": ordered,
311	        "order": [step["id"] for step in ordered],
312	    }
313	
314	
315	def run_plan(run):
316	    """Return the normalized DAG plan frozen into ``run`` at creation.
317	
318	    Newer documents carry an explicit snapshot under ``plan``; older ones
319	    reconstruct it via :func:`plan_from_run` from the run's own nodes and
320	    ordering.  The result is a fresh copy, so callers can never mutate the
321	    snapshot stored in the run document.
322	    """
323	    snapshot = run.get("plan")
324	    if not snapshot or not snapshot.get("steps"):
325	        snapshot = plan_from_run(run)
326	    return {
327	        "workflow_id": snapshot.get("workflow_id", run.get("workflow_id")),
328	        "steps": [dict(step) for step in snapshot.get("steps", [])],
329	        "order": list(snapshot.get("order", [])),
330	    }
331	
332	
333	def new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, now_iso, max_parallelism=None,
334	            idempotency_key=None, not_before=None, schedule_id=None, scheduled_at=None):
335	    """Build a fresh run document from a validated plan."""
336	    steps = {
337	        step["id"]: {
338	            "id": step["id"],
339	            "kind": step.get("kind", KIND_TASK),
340	            "depends_on": list(step["depends_on"]),
341	            "max_attempts": step["max_attempts"],
342	            "status": STEP_PENDING,
343	            "attempt": 0,
344	            "worker_id": None,
345	            "lease_deadline": None,
346	            "next_attempt_at": None,
347	            "ready_at": None,
348	            "started_at": None,
349	            "finished_at": None,
350	            "result": None,
351	            "error": None,
352	            "approval": None,
353	        }
354	        for step in plan["steps"]
355	    }
356	    return {
357	        "tenant": tenant,
358	        "workflow_id": workflow_id,
359	        "run_id": run_id,
360	        "status": RUN_PENDING,
361	        "params": params or {},
362	        "max_parallelism": max_parallelism,
363	        "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
364	        "not_before": not_before,
365	        "schedule_id": schedule_id,
366	        "scheduled_at": scheduled_at,
367	        "created_at": now_iso,
368	        "updated_at": now_iso,
369	        # The normalized DAG as it was when this run was created.  A later
370	        # submission of another workflow with the same id must not rewrite
371	        # this run's nodes, order, kinds, dependencies or max_attempts;
372	        # replay rebuilds exclusively from this snapshot.
373	        "plan": {
374	            "workflow_id": plan["workflow_id"],
375	            "steps": [dict(step) for step in plan["steps"]],
376	            "order": list(plan["order"]),
377	        },
378	        "step_order": list(plan["order"]),
379	        "order_index": {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(plan["order"])},
380	        "steps": steps,
381	        "history": [],
382	    }

42	        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
43	        if length <= 0:
44	            return {}
45	        if length > MAX_BODY:
46	            raise WorkflowError("request body too large", "body_too_large")
47	        try:
48	            payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
49	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
50	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be valid JSON", "bad_json")
51	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
52	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be a JSON object", "bad_json")
53	        return payload
54	
55	    def _tenant(self, query, body=None):
56	        tenant = (body or {}).get("tenant") or (query.get("tenant") or [None])[0]
57	        if not tenant:
58	            raise WorkflowError("tenant is required", "bad_tenant")
59	        return tenant
60	    # -- verbs ---------------------------------------------------------
61	    def do_GET(self):
62	        self._dispatch("GET")
63	
64	    def do_POST(self):
65	        self._dispatch("POST")
66	
67	    def _dispatch(self, method):
68	        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
69	        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/") or "/"
70	        try:
71	            self._route(method, path, parse_qs(parsed.query), parsed.query)
72	        except LeaseError as exc:
73	            self._error(409, exc.message)
74	        except ConflictError as exc:
75	            self._error(409, exc.message)
76	        except WorkflowError as exc:
77	            self._error(STATUS_FOR_CODE.get(exc.code, 400), exc.message)
78	        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
79	            self._error(500, "internal error: %s" % exc)
80	
81	    def _route(self, method, path, query, raw_query=""):
82	        body = {}
83	        if method == "GET":
84	            if path == "/healthz":
85	                return self._json(200, {"ok": True})
86	            if path == "/v1/runs":
87	                return self._list_runs(query)
88	            if path == "/v1/schedules":
89	                return self._list_schedules(query)
90	            if path == "/v1/workers":
91	                return self._list_workers(query)
92	            if path == "/v1/quotas":
93	                return self._get_quota(query)
94	            if path == "/v1/audit":
95	                # Blank values count as "provided" here: an empty tenant,
96	                # action or run_id is a 400, not a missing parameter.
97	                return self._list_audit(parse_qs(raw_query, keep_blank_values=True))
98	        elif method == "POST":
99	            if path == "/v1/tasks/claim":
100	                return self._claim_any_task(self._body())
101	            if path == "/v1/workers/register":
102	                return self._register_worker(self._body())
103	            worker_beat = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/workers/([^/]+)/heartbeat", path)
104	            if worker_beat:
105	                return self._worker_heartbeat(unquote(worker_beat.group(1)), self._body())
106	            if path == "/v1/workflows":
107	                body = self._body()
108	                tenant = self._tenant({}, body)
109	                plan = self.scheduler.submit(tenant, body.get("workflow_id"), body.get("steps"))
110	                return self._json(201, dict(plan, tenant=tenant))
111	            if path == "/v1/runs":
112	                body = self._body()
113	                run = self.scheduler.start_run(self._tenant({}, body), body.get("workflow_id"),
114	                                               body.get("run_id"), body.get("params"),
115	                                               body.get("max_parallelism"),
116	                                               body.get("idempotency_key"),
117	                                               body.get("not_before"))
118	                return self._json(201, _run_view(run))
119	            if path == "/v1/schedules":
120	                return self._create_schedule(self._body())
121	            if path == "/v1/quotas":
122	                return self._set_quota(self._body())
123	            schedule_dispatch = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/schedules/([^/]+)/dispatch", path)
124	            if schedule_dispatch:
125	                return self._dispatch_schedule(unquote(schedule_dispatch.group(1)), self._body())
126	            action = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)/(claim|complete|fail|decision|heartbeat|cancel)", path)
127	            if action:
128	                if action.group(2) == "decision":
129	                    return self._decision(action.group(1), self._body())
130	                if action.group(2) == "heartbeat":
131	                    return self._heartbeat(action.group(1), self._body())
132	                if action.group(2) == "cancel":
133	                    return self._cancel(action.group(1), self._body())
134	                return self._step_action(action.group(1), action.group(2), self._body())
135	        solo = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)", path)
136	        if method == "GET" and solo:

138	        return self._error(404, "no route for %s %s" % (method, path))
